name: Sinpie
source: "Sinpie is unlike all the other girls in Star Girls. She has direct access to one of the most advanced civilizations databases and with her cybernetic, she is far more superior than any other race in the galaxy. Since Sinpie has only been alive for 3 years everything is new to her, including relationships and the emotional growing pains that come with your first love."
